notes: Protection warrior at 60 in Defensive Stance with a shield: Shield Slam and Revenge on cooldown, Shield Block whenever its buff is down, Thunder Clap held on the boss, Sunder Armor as the global-cooldown filler and Heroic Strike with spare rage. Every priority was measured on the engine's tank harness (a level 63 boss, one 2 second melee swing, steady healing; sim/warrior/tank_warrior's TestRotationVariations records the figures): Shield Block cuts damage taken by about 18 percent, a Thunder Clap upkeep by another 16 percent for 6 percent of threat, Sunder Armor as the filler adds about 24 percent threat, and the Heroic Strike threshold moves nothing because a Forever tank is cooldown-limited, not rage-limited, at this gear. Last Stand and Shield Wall are gated on health: they never fire on a fight the healers hold and cut the chance of death on one they do not. Demoralizing Shout is not in the rotation: it takes attack power off the boss, and the curated tank boss has none to take. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build.

expected_idle.reason: Shield Block needs a shield and the ladder's character carries none (its off hand is a weapon slot only for dual-wielding classes), so the engine refuses the cast at every level. A tank in the tank fight, shield on, casts it about 34 times in 180 seconds.

Shield Slam needs a shield for the same reason (its cast condition is a shield in the off hand), so the shieldless ladder character never casts it. In the tank fight it lands on every cooldown, about 30 times in 180 seconds.
Defensive Stance is a stance-dance guard, not part of the cycle: the engine starts a tank warrior in it (sim/warrior/tank_warrior's tankStance) so the cast condition, not being in it, is never true.

Shield Wall is gated on health below 40 percent and on a shield; the ladder fight does not hurt the character, so it correctly never fires. The tank harness shows it cutting the chance of death on a boss the healers cannot hold.

sources.label: Talents Forever Deep Dive stream: Shield Block 2 charges and 7 s, Thunder Clap usable in Defensive Stance, Shield Wall 15 min / 60 percent for 12 s (single-source)

priorityList.notes: Stay in Defensive Stance: the 30 percent threat, Revenge and Shield Wall all need it. The engine starts a tank in it, so this fires only after a stance dance.
Last Stand below 35 percent health: 30 percent of maximum health for 20 seconds, lost afterwards. Never fires on a fight the healers hold.
Shield Wall below 40 percent health: 60 percent less damage taken for 12 seconds. Fifteen minute cooldown, so once a fight.
Bloodrage on cooldown while rage is under 60: ten rage now and one a second for ten seconds.
Shield Block whenever its buff is down: 75 percent more block for 7 seconds or two blocks. Recasting over a live buff wastes rage, and the measured damage taken is the same.
Revenge the moment it is available: it only lights after a dodge, parry or block, costs 5 rage (2 with Focused Rage 3) and is the most threat per rage on the bar.
Shield Slam on cooldown: the biggest hit on the bar, damage plus block value and a very high amount of threat.
Keep Thunder Clap on the boss: the 20 percent attack speed slow is the largest cut to damage taken after Shield Block, and it lasts 30 seconds, so refresh inside the last 3.
Sunder Armor is the global-cooldown filler: flat threat on every cast and the armor it strips raises the tank's own damage.
Heroic Strike with spare rage: the best threat per rage after Revenge, and it costs no global cooldown. Queued only above 40 rage so the cooldown buttons are never starved.
